selectedResponsibility.description: Enumerate viable schema variants and construct valid/negative cases, optional/minimal payloads and discriminator cases.

residualResponsibilities.description: Locate endpoint, extract request/response schemas and recursively resolve dependencies.
Generate complete Drift operations and dataset YAML, correct targets, tags, auth exclusions and negative-schema flags.
Explain status/variant counts, chosen combinations and intentionally excluded gaps.
When variants depend on live state, arrange dataset or lifecycle hooks and cleanup.
